"""
N-gram LM Perplexity Scorer (CPU-only)
Train trigram on real (depth=0) text, score all 371K samples.
"""

import json
import math
import os
import sys
import time
import re
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

DATA_DIR = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/provenance_weight_training/data")
INPUT_FILE = DATA_DIR / "scored_data.jsonl"
OUTPUT_FILE = DATA_DIR / "scored_data_ngram.jsonl"
CHECKPOINT_FILE = DATA_DIR / "ngram_checkpoint.json"

N = 3
SMOOTHING_K = 0.01
MAX_VOCAB = 100000
MIN_NGRAM_COUNT = 2
CHECKPOINT_EVERY = 50000
LOG_EVERY = 10000

_tok_re = re.compile(r"\w+|[^\w\s]")

def tokenize(text):
    return _tok_re.findall(text.lower())


class NgramLM:
    def __init__(self):
        self.ngram_counts = {}
        self.context_counts = {}
        self.vocab = set()
        self.V = 0

    def train(self, records):
        print(f"Training {N}-gram LM on {len(records)} real samples...", flush=True)
        t0 = time.time()

        unigram = Counter()
        for i, rec in enumerate(records):
            unigram.update(tokenize(rec["text"]))
            if (i + 1) % 50000 == 0:
                print(f"  vocab scan: {i+1}/{len(records)}, {len(unigram)} unique tokens", flush=True)

        self.vocab = set(tok for tok, _ in unigram.most_common(MAX_VOCAB))
        self.vocab.update(["<UNK>", "<BOS>", "<EOS>"])
        self.V = len(self.vocab)
        print(f"  Vocab size: {self.V}", flush=True)

        ngram_c = Counter()
        for i, rec in enumerate(records):
            toks = tokenize(rec["text"])
            toks = [t if t in self.vocab else "<UNK>" for t in toks]
            toks = ["<BOS>"] * (N - 1) + toks + ["<EOS>"]
            for j in range(N - 1, len(toks)):
                ngram_c[tuple(toks[j - N + 1 : j + 1])] += 1
            if (i + 1) % 50000 == 0:
                print(f"  ngram count: {i+1}/{len(records)}, {len(ngram_c)} unique {N}-grams", flush=True)

        before = len(ngram_c)
        self.ngram_counts = {k: v for k, v in ngram_c.items() if v >= MIN_NGRAM_COUNT}
        del ngram_c

        self.context_counts = Counter()
        for ng, c in self.ngram_counts.items():
            self.context_counts[ng[:-1]] += c

        elapsed = time.time() - t0
        print(f"  Done in {elapsed:.1f}s: {before} -> {len(self.ngram_counts)} {N}-grams (pruned count<{MIN_NGRAM_COUNT})", flush=True)
        print(f"  Contexts: {len(self.context_counts)}", flush=True)

    def score_ppl(self, text):
        toks = tokenize(text)
        toks = [t if t in self.vocab else "<UNK>" for t in toks]
        toks = ["<BOS>"] * (N - 1) + toks + ["<EOS>"]
        log_prob_sum = 0.0
        cnt = 0
        kV = SMOOTHING_K * self.V
        for j in range(N - 1, len(toks)):
            ng = tuple(toks[j - N + 1 : j + 1])
            ctx = ng[:-1]
            nc = self.ngram_counts.get(ng, 0)
            cc = self.context_counts.get(ctx, 0)
            log_prob_sum += math.log((nc + SMOOTHING_K) / (cc + kV))
            cnt += 1
        if cnt == 0:
            return 99999.0
        return math.exp(-log_prob_sum / cnt)


def main():
    print("Loading data...", flush=True)
    all_data = []
    with open(INPUT_FILE) as f:
        for line in f:
            all_data.append(json.loads(line))
    total = len(all_data)
    real_data = [r for r in all_data if r["depth"] == 0]
    synth_data = [r for r in all_data if r["depth"] == 1]
    print(f"Total: {total}, Real: {len(real_data)}, Synth: {len(synth_data)}", flush=True)

    lm = NgramLM()
    lm.train(real_data)

    start_idx = 0
    results = []
    if CHECKPOINT_FILE.exists():
        ckpt = json.loads(CHECKPOINT_FILE.read_text())
        start_idx = ckpt["processed"]
        print(f"Resuming from checkpoint at {start_idx}", flush=True)
        with open(OUTPUT_FILE) as f:
            for line in f:
                results.append(json.loads(line))
        start_idx = len(results)

    print(f"\nScoring {total} samples (starting from {start_idx})...", flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    out_f = open(OUTPUT_FILE, "a" if start_idx > 0 else "w")

    for i in range(start_idx, total):
        rec = all_data[i]
        ppl = lm.score_ppl(rec["text"])
        rec["ngram_ppl"] = round(ppl, 4) if math.isfinite(ppl) and ppl < 1e8 else 99999.0
        out_f.write(json.dumps(rec) + "\n")
        results.append(rec)

        done = len(results)
        if done % LOG_EVERY == 0:
            elapsed = time.time() - t0
            rate = (done - start_idx) / elapsed if elapsed > 0 else 0
            eta = (total - done) / rate if rate > 0 else 0
            print(f"  [{done}/{total}] {rate:.0f} samples/s, ETA {eta/60:.1f}min", flush=True)
            out_f.flush()

        if done % CHECKPOINT_EVERY == 0:
            out_f.flush()
            CHECKPOINT_FILE.write_text(json.dumps({"processed": done}))
            print(f"  Checkpoint at {done}", flush=True)

    out_f.close()
    if CHECKPOINT_FILE.exists():
        CHECKPOINT_FILE.unlink()

    elapsed_total = time.time() - t0
    scored = total - start_idx
    print(f"\nScoring done: {scored} samples in {elapsed_total/60:.1f}min ({scored/max(elapsed_total,1):.0f} samples/s)", flush=True)

    # --- Statistics ---
    depths = np.array([r["depth"] for r in results])
    ngram_ppls = np.array([r["ngram_ppl"] for r in results])
    q_scores = np.array([r["q_score"] for r in results])

    real_mask = depths == 0
    synth_mask = depths == 1
    valid = ngram_ppls < 99999

    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"N-gram PPL Statistics (n={N}, k={SMOOTHING_K})")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    for label, mask in [("Real  (depth=0)", real_mask), ("Synth (depth=1)", synth_mask)]:
        m = mask & valid
        v = ngram_ppls[m]
        print(f"{label}: n={m.sum()}, mean={v.mean():.2f}, median={np.median(v):.2f}, std={v.std():.2f}")
        print(f"  p5={np.percentile(v,5):.2f}, p25={np.percentile(v,25):.2f}, p75={np.percentile(v,75):.2f}, p95={np.percentile(v,95):.2f}")

    from scipy.stats import spearmanr, pearsonr
    cm = valid & np.isfinite(q_scores)
    pr = pearsonr(q_scores[cm], ngram_ppls[cm])
    sr = spearmanr(q_scores[cm], ngram_ppls[cm])
    print(f"\nCorrelation with q_score:")
    print(f"  Pearson:  r={pr.statistic:.4f}, p={pr.pvalue:.2e}")
    print(f"  Spearman: r={sr.statistic:.4f}, p={sr.pvalue:.2e}")

    from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
    labels = depths[valid]
    scores = ngram_ppls[valid]
    auc_high = roc_auc_score(labels, scores)
    auc_low = roc_auc_score(labels, -scores)
    best_dir = "higher" if auc_high >= auc_low else "lower"
    best_auc = max(auc_high, auc_low)
    print(f"\nAUC ({best_dir} ngram_ppl = synthetic): {best_auc:.4f}")

    best_acc, best_t = 0, 0
    for pct in range(1, 100):
        t = np.percentile(scores, pct)
        if best_dir == "higher":
            pred_s = ngram_ppls > t
        else:
            pred_s = ngram_ppls < t
        correct = (pred_s & synth_mask) | (~pred_s & real_mask)
        acc = correct[valid].mean()
        if acc > best_acc:
            best_acc, best_t = acc, t
    print(f"Best threshold: {best_t:.2f}, accuracy: {best_acc:.4f}")
    print(f"\nOutput: {OUTPUT_FILE}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PYEOF
